column7: Variant: dining room with a solid parota table for six and woven chairs, a low wooden sideboard on the right with a clay pot; no pendant lamp.
Variant: bedroom with a wooden bed dressed in white and sand linen, a simple nightstand and lamp on the right.

The problem: rising damp with salt efflorescence (salitre) at the base of the wall: a white powdery crust and blistered, flaking paint up to about 60 cm above the floor, with a darker damp band above the baseboard. A wooden chair has been moved away from the wall.
Variant: two-storey house; the solid wooden front door and its steps on the right half, black steel windows, a small olive tree at the right edge.
The six cards are warm earthy rose and terracotta tones; the natural object is a halved guava.
The roller has covered about half of the wall: the fresh new color on the left, the old off-white on the right.
Variant: living room with a low linen sofa slightly to the right, a wooden side table, a handwoven rug.
Variant: living room with a low sofa, a ceramic table lamp on the right, a tall window on the right edge showing deep blue dusk.

On the bench, slightly right of center, a small wrought-iron plant stand about 40 cm tall, freshly painted in glossy dark green enamel, standing on a sheet of brown kraft paper. The left half of the bench in front of it is clear.
